name: Call of Earth
summary: In Durotar, you seek the earth spirit’s favor and return to Canaga Earthcaller with rough quartz. He shapes it into your first elemental totem.

sections.title: Heart of the Stone
sections.body: A novice shaman seeks the earth through patience and humility. Brute strength will not win the spirit’s favor. The Minor Manifestation of Earth gives you rough quartz. That small stone proves the spirit has accepted your pledge, and it holds the seed of power.

sections.title: The First of Four Paths
sections.body:
You complete the trial when you bring the quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials. Canaga shapes it into an Earth Totem, the focus through which you channel the ground’s steadfast protection and strength.

Earth begins your path through the four elemental disciplines. The rite lays the foundation for a lifetime of communion with the natural world.

faq.q: What is the rough quartz used for?
faq.answer: The rough quartz is a token from the Minor Manifestation of Earth and proof that you have communed with the spirit. Canaga Earthcaller sets it into your Earth Totem as its heart and as a focus for your earth spells.

Canaga Earthcaller trains shaman in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He guides young orc and troll initiates through their earliest trials, preparing them to commune with elemental spirits and shaping their first totems.

aliases: can tauren do durotar call of earth
faq.answer: Yes. Tauren usually complete their trial of earth with their own elders at Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Any Horde shaman who travels to the Valley of Trials can undergo the ritual with Canaga Earthcaller.

faq.q: What does receiving the Earth Totem signify?
faq.answer: Receiving an Earth Totem signifies that the spirit of the earth has recognized you. It marks your standing among shaman and gives you a physical focus for earth-based blessings and wards.

faq.q: What virtues does the earth demand from a shaman?
faq.answer: The spirit asks an initiate for patience, strength, and wisdom. Even the smallest pebble can outlast mountains through endurance. The earth teaches shaman to respect the ground, so it will support them in turn.

faq.q: Where does the shaman path go after this?
faq.answer: Earth is the first of the four elements a shaman must master. As your training continues, you are called to seek communion with the spirits of fire, water, and air.

angles.text: As a shaman, this rite gives you your first totem. It lets you ground yourself in the elements and call upon the soil for aid.
As an orc, you take part in the revival of orcish shamanism in Durotar. You turn back toward elemental balance after decades of demonic corruption.
As a troll, you learn beside the orcs in the Valley of Trials. You adapt the Darkspear witch doctors’ and spiritualists’ traditional communion to include the four elemental paths.
As a member of the Horde, you know Kalimdor’s elements are wild and untamed. The bond Horde shaman forge with them is essential to the survival of their new settlements.
